description: Score state for tennis, golf handicap differentials and cricket overs — Replays a tennis point sequence (ITF Rules of Tennis: games, deuce, tie-breaks, match tie-break, who serves), computes a golf Score Differential and Handicap Index (World Handicap System), or tallies a cricket innings ball by ball (overs.balls, wides and no-balls, maidens, wickets), for agents that must verify a reported score. Optionally checks a claimed score against the replay and names the fir

cricket.description: For sport=cricket: one innings, ball by ball.

inningsOver.description: Claimed that the innings has ended (needs maxOvers or all wickets down).

runs.description: ball: runs scored. wide/noball: runs in addition to the 1-run penalty. Default 0.

runsKind.description: Whose runs: default bat. Not for wides.

type.description: ball: a valid delivery. wide / noball: delivery that does not count (Laws 21, 22). dead: called dead before the striker could play it (Law 17.3.2.1).

wicket.description: A batter was dismissed on this delivery.

maxOvers.description: Innings limit in overs, if any.

maxWickets.description: Wickets that end the innings. Default 10.

golf.description: For sport=golf: a round, a list of differentials, or both.

differentials.description: Scoring record, oldest first; the most recent 20 are used.

lowHandicapIndex.description: Low Handicap Index (365 days), used only to detect that the soft cap would apply.

adjustedGrossScore.description: 18-hole adjusted gross score. Give this or holes.

holes.description: Exactly 18 holes; each score is limited to net double bogey (par + 2 + strokes), or par + 5 before a Handicap Index exists.

strokes.description: Handicap strokes received (negative for a plus handicap).

indexEstablished.description: Default true. False: limit holes to par + 5 (Rule 3.1a).

pcc.description: Playing Conditions Calculation adjustment, -1.0 to +3.0 (Rule 5.1a). Default 0.

sport.description: Selects which block below is read.

claim.description: Optional claims to verify against the replay.

games.description: Games in the current set [a, b] (0-0 after a set ends).

finalSet.description: tiebreak (default): 7-point tie-break at 6-6 in every set. advantage: no tie-break in the final set. super-tiebreak-10: a 10-point tie-break replaces the final set (Appendix VI).

firstServer.description: Who serves the first game. Default a.

noAd.description: Appendix VI No-Ad: a deciding point at deuce. Default false.

points.description: Point winners from the first point of the match, one character each: "a" or "b" (players, not server/receiver). Up to 2000.

name: score-state
